title: RAI launches on Ethereum mainnet
description: Reflexer launched RAI as an ETH-backed stable-value asset using a floating protocol redemption price rather than a fixed one-dollar peg.
notes: Launch date is corroborated by Reflexer community resources and contemporary protocol material.

title: RAI governance-minimization process
description: Reflexer documentation describes a staged process for removing or constraining governance control over RAI components while retaining maintenance for infrastructure that cannot be fully ungoverned.
notes: No single completion date is assigned because the official material describes stages and component-specific constraints.

title: Paxos launches PAX Gold
description: Paxos launched PAXG as an Ethereum token representing one fine troy ounce of London Good Delivery gold held in professional London vaults and redeemable through Paxos subject to terms.
notes: Official Paxos launch release and whitepaper.

title: Tether Gold XAU₮ launches
description: Tether announced XAU₮ as a token providing ownership of allocated physical gold, with one token representing one fine troy ounce on an LBMA Good Delivery bar.
notes: Official Tether launch release and Tether Gold product documentation.

title: SPOT v2 rollout
description: Ampleforth governance initiated a SPOT v2 rollout to update the perpetual-note system and collateral rotation mechanics. SOG treats this as protocol-version history rather than a new asset identity.
notes: Exact production activation date and complete v2 contract set remain known unknowns.

title: NUON goes live on Base
description: Nuon documentation states that NUON launched on Base, where eligible users can deposit USDC to mint NUON and interact with the protocol contracts.
notes: The official pages confirm live Base deployment but do not provide a single durable launch date.

title: Nuon v2 guarded-launch phase
description: Nuon documentation describes a controlled guarded-launch phase combining NUON minting and staking with MaxCap distribution before broader deployment.
notes: Documentation gives a February–April 2025 phase window, but no artificial day-level date is assigned.
